concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-get-grant-balances]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Capital GET routes for account-holder grant lists, individual grant balances/status/renewal fields and grant-account aggregate balances/limits; examples are not live debt or disbursement proof.
warnings: List and single-grant samples conflict: grant 2 renews grant 1 in the list, while grant 1 renews grant 2 in the single response; status is object versus string. Do not merge into a single actual ledger or infer universal response shape.
The grant-account section calls the id a query parameter, but route and curl put it in the path; preserve route identity.
Example balances lack as-of timing and do not prove current debt, actual repayment, disbursement or bank receipt; negative limits in the sample are not a user cash balance.
